I wanted to see how our bean plant grew, so I watched it for an hour. Nothing seemed to happen. My sister said I needed a longer video, not more time beside the window.

We took one photo each morning for two weeks. Then we put the photos together on the computer and played them quickly. The little plant opened and moved towards the light in seconds.
